title: Xylkstream
tagline: Automatically deploy streaming tokens as Uniswap and DeepBook liquidity while they vest.
description:
Multi-tenant vesting platform where your unvested funds work for you. Stream payments to anyone while AI agents automatically deploy idle capital to the highest-yield markets across Sui and EVM chains. Hot-swappable yield strategies. Real-time optimization. You set policy. AI maximizes returns.

Payment streams (salary, contractor payments, vesting schedules) and unvested funds automatically earn yield while waiting to be claimed. AI agents monitor markets in real-time, moving capital between DeepBook (Sui) and Uniswap v4 (EVM) pools to maximize returns. Recipients get their scheduled payments plus accumulated fees—completely automated.
how_its_made:
Multi-tenant by design. Each user gets isolated wallet, yield policy, and plugin storage. One user runs conservative streams with USDC-USDT only. Another experiments with volatile pairs and aggressive rebalancing. They never collide. Server handles multiple portfolios without cross-contamination.

Plugin isolation via workerd. Yield strategies are MCP servers running in separate workerd containers (Cloudflare's Worker runtime). Local dev loads from filesystem. Production pulls from GitHub via cron. They hot-swap without server restart and communicate via Cap'n Proto RPC. New DeepBook integration drops in. Better Uniswap v4 strategy replaces old one. Core logic never changes. Content-hash versioning prevents conflicts.

AI agents execute within Users defined Policy-driven yield optimization, logging every rebalancing decision to immutable audit trail. Your policy evolves. Your risk tolerance adjusts. The agent follows.

Cross-chain execution via LI.FI. Stream creation supports any EVM source chain (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon). LI.FI SDK handles bridging and routing to target chain (Sui or EVM). Single UX for users. Agents monitor LI.FI transaction status and confirm stream creation. Pay from anywhere. Stream anywhere.
